about: Shared consumer-rule cases. release-compat's checkInstall, station_cli's catalog, the kiosk's CompatibilityData and install.sh's jq rule must all give `installable` for every case. A case's `channel` (production | development) is the channel of the installing station: floors are read from requires[Y].channels[channel]; no `channel`, or a requirement without `channels`, uses the top-level floor. Copy this file verbatim; the source of truth is release-compat/test/fixtures/consumer-parity.json.
